Additional Tools

The original user-supplied GUI and its resources are preserved. This bundle does
not imply affiliation with NHK or the original application author.

Installer: Inno Setup 6.7.3, https://jrsoftware.org/isdl.php
Source: https://github.com/jrsoftware/issrc
Chinese translation: https://github.com/kira-96/Inno-Setup-Chinese-Simplified-Translation

N_m3u8DL-RE 0.6.0-beta, original release binary, https://github.com/nilaoda/N_m3u8DL-RE
Release: https://github.com/nilaoda/N_m3u8DL-RE/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta
License: MIT; full text in License-01.txt

Shaka Packager 3.9.3, original release binary, https://github.com/shaka-project/shaka-packager
Release: https://github.com/shaka-project/shaka-packager/releases/tag/v3.9.3
License: Apache-2.0; full text in License-02.txt

FFmpeg 7.1 (ffmpeg-win-x86_64-v7.1.exe), from original application's imageio_ffmpeg.
Project/source: https://ffmpeg.org/ and https://github.com/imageio/imageio-ffmpeg
Build includes GPL components; full license text in License-03.txt.
Corresponding build provenance is in imageio-ffmpeg and its FFmpeg build scripts.
Source/build information: https://github.com/imageio/imageio-ffmpeg/tree/main/ffmpeg

PySide6 / Qt: original user-supplied runtime, https://www.qt.io/licensing/
Qt for Python: https://doc.qt.io/qtforpython-6/licenses.html
Python: https://www.python.org/psf/license/
PyInstaller bootloader exception: https://pyinstaller.org/en/stable/license.html
Tcl/Tk: https://www.tcl.tk/software/tcltk/license.html

Only the subtitle text cleaner and companion CLI are newly implemented here.
No screenshot-author conversion utility was downloaded or executed.
Original bundled dependency notices and dist-info metadata remain in _internal.
